options.label: Phone snapshot
options.text: Taken by a friend on an iPhone main camera, held at chest height about a metre away, default photo mode, no portrait blur.
options.finish: It looks like an ordinary unedited iPhone photo: natural colours, true-to-life skin tones, the slight HDR flatness phones give a bright window, a touch of sensor noise in the shadows, and sharpness that falls off softly rather than looking crisp or retouched.
options.note: Text and finish are the tested camera and closing-look lines; the finish goes last.
